CorePatch N local integration

Upstream: https://github.com/LSPosed/CorePatch
Revision: ddf87bb5fb2bb2eb962992103abf0b225952d738
Authors: LSPosed/CorePatch contributors; upstream Git history retains individual authorship.
Upstream README declares GNU General Public License v2.0.
The upstream snapshot has no standalone LICENSE file or explicit later-version permission.
This notice does not relicense upstream code under ONextBox's GPL v3.
License compatibility/redistribution authorization remains unresolved; do not treat this
local integration or a successful build as permission to redistribute the combined binary.

Imported sources: app/src/main/java/org/lsposed/corepatch/hook/*.kt and Constant.kt.
Adapted sources: Config.kt and XposedHelper.kt; localized option text from upstream resources.
Original upstream README is retained alongside this notice.

ONextBox adaptations:
- API 102 callback bridge uses the existing registry, exception handling and lifecycle.
- Preferences use a corepatch_ prefix and all default to false.
- Settings are captured at system_server startup. Every change requires a phone reboot.
- Active CorePatch rejects module hot replacement to protect signing/shared-UID state.
- MessageDigest bypass is restricted to Android APK/JAR verification call stacks.
- Signing capability gates preserve permission/auth capability bits, including combinations.
- V1 certificate chains are converted from Collection to Certificate[] when needed.
- Dedicated settings page, enable confirmation, search and configuration inventory.

No upstream standalone application, Xposed entry point, icon or package identity is bundled.
Do not activate this integration alongside the standalone CorePatch module.
